name: Qwen-Image 2.1 Reference Edit
description: Qwen-Image 2.1 makes a new image from one to three reference images and a plain-English instruction, such as putting the shirt from <image2> on the person in <image1>. Say what changes and what stays. Qwen Research License: non-commercial use only.

prompt.description: An instruction, not a scene description. Name what changes, then what stays, and refer to references as <image1>, <image2> in the order they were sent: image is <image1>, then images in order ('Keep the person and pose in <image1> unchanged, put the jacket from <image2> on them').

image_2.description: Optional second reference. Send it through the request's images list rather than setting it directly, so Studio stages it on the node.

image_3.description: Optional third reference, sent the same way as image_2.

negative_prompt.description: Only read when cfg is above 1.

reference_resolution.description: Each reference is resized to about this many pixels squared, keeping its aspect ratio; the output comes out at the first reference's size. 0 keeps each reference at its own size.

steps.description: ComfyUI's template runs 25; Qwen's own examples run 40.

cfg.description: Keep at 1 for the official path. Raise it only to use a negative prompt.

clip.description: Text encoder file on the node. The default is the int8 build; qwen3vl_8b_w4a8.safetensors (6.31 GB) is a smaller one from the same repo for nodes short on system RAM.
